title: Down the Left of the Page
subtitle: 报刊与专栏 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 报刊与专栏（社会服务与人际沟通·新闻与传媒）
meta: 主题语境：报刊与专栏（社会服务与人际沟通·新闻与传媒）　|　核心词汇：column　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 column 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1954 my grandmother ① wrote a column about nothing that happened, and she said the writing was the whole of the noticing. The ② column, meaning the space and not the news, ran down the left of the page and stayed there; column, she said, is the only thing in a newspaper that is judged by how little happens in it.

Every ③ column in that paper had the same width, and the ④ column at the end, meaning the one she kept for weather and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever cut out twice. Column, my mother said, is nine parts noticing and one part somebody willing to fill the space; my grandmother said the noticing is the part that fills the page.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ a column of soldiers was the whole of the afternoon, meaning the line and not the page. The ⑥ column, meaning the line and not any of that, is the only thing in an afternoon that everybody follows and nobody questions; column, he said, is either something you write or the only word that means both a page and a line. She said the line is the part they remember.

By 1962 the ⑦ column had become a name at the top of the page, and the name had become an argument about who was allowed to write. The ⑧ column of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in October, was one page and forty years of noticing; column, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to look down the left. He said the looking was never mentioned.

The ⑨ column I remember is the one at the end, which was printed in 1968 and is still described as the narrowest in the county. A ⑩ column, my mother said in 1970, is the only thing that improves by being cut out; every column, she said, is a noticing that has agreed to look like a page. She said the noticing was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 专栏（指那一版版面本身，与那些新闻相对）
C. 固定搭配：write a column 写专栏
D. n. 专栏（指那份报纸上每一篇）
E. n. 专栏（指末尾那一篇）
F. 固定搭配：a column of soldiers 一队士兵
G. n. 纵队；长列（指那支队伍本身）
H. n. 舆论阵地；发声渠道（抽象总称）

items.q: wrote a column about nothing that happened
The column, meaning the space and not the news
a column of soldiers was the whole of the afternoon
the column had become a name at the top of the page
The column of the whole thing
A column, my mother said in 1970

answers.why: write a column 意为“写专栏”，1954 年祖母写了一篇关于什么都没发生的专栏。
column 意为“专栏”，指那一版版面本身而不是那些新闻，它沿着页面左侧排下去。
column 指那份报纸上每一篇专栏，每一篇都是同样的宽度。
column 指末尾那一篇（她留给天气的那一篇），是唯一有人剪过两次的。
a column of soldiers 意为“一队士兵”，父亲说那一队士兵就是那个下午的全部。
column 意为“纵队、长列”，指那支队伍本身而不是那张版面，是下午里人人都跟着走、却无人质疑的东西。
column 意为“专栏”，到 1962 年这个专栏成了页面顶端的一个名字。
column 意为“舆论阵地、发声渠道”，祖母十月写道，整件事的发声渠道是一张版面四十年的留意。
column 意为“专栏”，我记得的是末尾那一篇，1968 年刊出，至今仍被说成全县最窄的。
column 为抽象总称，母亲说一篇专栏是唯一会因为被剪下来而变好的东西。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1954 年祖母写了一篇关于什么都没发生的专栏，她说写作才是这整个留意的全部。（write a column）
那个专栏，指的是那一版版面而不是那些新闻，沿着页面左侧排下去，并且一直排在那儿。（column）
那份报纸上每一篇专栏都是同样的宽度。（column）
末尾那一篇专栏，指的是她留给天气的那一篇，是唯一有人剪过两次的。（column）
父亲说那一队士兵就是那个下午的全部，指的是那支队伍而不是那张版面。（a column of soldiers）
1970 年母亲说，一篇专栏是唯一会因为被剪下来而变好的东西。（column）
answers: In 1954 my grandmother wrote a column about nothing that happened, and she said the writing was the whole of the noticing.
The column, meaning the space and not the news, ran down the left of the page and stayed there.
Every column in that paper had the same width.
The column at the end, meaning the one she kept for weather and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever cut out twice.
My father said a column of soldiers was the whole of the afternoon, meaning the line and not the page.
A column, my mother said in 1970, is the only thing that improves by being cut out.
